resampling: Draw G time groups with replacement from the G observed effective TEST groups using numpy.default_rng(seed).multinomial(G, equal probabilities). All events, targets and methods within each selected group travel together.
acceptance: Keep the first5000 draws with at least one positive and one negative for every fixed target. Redraw rejected replicates; report attempted/rejected/unused-generated counts. Do not change the macro target set.
thresholds: Each method has its own cutoffs from the same labeled CALIB cohort. Reuse all cutoffs verbatim on TEST and in bootstrap; no test calibration.
new_architecture_recipe: Choose exactly one recipe using v16primary CALIB macrorecall at10FP/10k, tie macroAUROC, then declared mean/native/context128 order. Apply that same recipe to v16_no_relations and random. Preserve all3 CALIB candidate traces.
legacy_controls: v15 fixed translation006 matcher; raw48 fixed centered grayscale48x48 template. No TEST-based switching.
target_set: Metadata-eligible intersection of old19 target types with at least10 fresh groups; exact ordered targets and class counts are bound before pixel access by the cohort roster, and before TEST by the CALIB supplement.
supplements_required: Exact CALIB NPZ hash, ordered target/method roster and cutoff digest.
Frozen protocol file hash, linked to this plan and the CALIB binding, before the TEST score artifact exists.
limitations: Additional labeled calibration events are supervision beyond the one enrolled image, even without natural-image gradient training.
Results are conditional on chosen references, trained checkpoints, CALIB recipe/cutoffs and the observed cohort.
Event-time grouping handles known dependence but does not prove independent physical events.
Positive-presence rejection conditions the bootstrap; sparse target classes still give unstable intervals.
Intervals are pointwise percentile intervals, not familywise multiplicity-adjusted.
FP per10,000 is normalized from observed negative counts, not a claim of10,000 independent negatives.
No trained arm or ablation will be promoted after viewing TEST.
